style.lockText: Campaign Style Lock: consistent premium metal travel-gear ecommerce visual system across the entire image set; fixed palette of seamless white background #FFFFFF, ink-black band and text #1A1A1A, brushed silver-grey metallic tone #C7CBCF, and one signal-red accent #D0342C; neutral-cool studio mood; modern geometric sans-serif short bold headlines only; flat solid circular badges and thin-line callout icons; clean high-end product photography mixed with minimal infographic elements; stable product scale and placement with clean breathing margins around the product; no color palette changes, no mixed fonts, no random backgrounds, no inconsistent lighting, no mismatched icon styles.
style.presentationRules: stable centered front 3/4 hero angle for packshots; consistent scale across spec and variant lineups; product always grounded with a contact shadow
